Entries.Text: Auto-Load Project on Smithbox Start
Load the previous project automatically when Smithbox starts.
Enable Automatic Auto-Load Assignment
Mark each project you load for auto-load.
Default Project Directory
The default folder offered when choosing the project folder for a new project.
Default Data Directory
The default folder offered when choosing the data folder for a new project.
Enable Backup Saves
Create backup files (.bak and .prev) when saving.
Enable Timestamp Backups for Regulation
Create timestamped backups of regulation files on save.
Detect New Files in the Project Folder

Detect new files that exist only in the project folder. Needed if you work with custom files and want them to appear in Smithbox.
When off, projects start faster.
Strict Project Folder Scan
Validate each file further before adding it to the project's file list.
Prefer Loose Files over Archives in VFS
Make the VFS prefer loose files over the files inside archives.
Enable Automatic Save
Save all enabled editors automatically.
Automatic Save Interval
How often the automatic save runs, in seconds.
Include Map Editor
Include the Map Editor in automatic saves.
Include Param Editor
Include the Param Editor in automatic saves.
Include Text Editor
Include the Text Editor in automatic saves.
Include Graphics Param Editor
Include the Gparam Editor in automatic saves.
Include Material Editor
Include the Material Editor in automatic saves.
ME3 Profile Directory
The folder to put generated ME3 profiles in.
